releaseNotes:
Sale invoice printing aur settings management ko behtar banaya gaya hai.

A4/A5 ke liye Classic aur Compact formats, inline logo, item-name font size, live preview zoom aur separate header repeat controls add kiye gaye hain.
Sale screen settings ab database mein save hoti hain aur invoice format/migration errors fix kiye gaye hain.
